rationale.conceptual: The method uses established MD techniques (Green-Kubo, stress-strain), but correctly implementing defect configurations, equilibration protocols, and extracting reliable properties from short MD runs requires domain knowledge. rationale.execution: The workflow includes generating multiple defective graphene structures, running NPT equilibration (500 ps) for each, tensile loading simulations, equilibrium Green-Kubo runs with averaging (3x2), and a temperature sweep (9 points). That constitutes a multi-stage pipeline with dependencies and post-processing.
